title: The Lost Escarpment
author: Sebastian Voss
blurb: Orsen Blackwood, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
